_provenance: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems table (ps), default parameter set row for TRAPPIST-1 b, retrieved 2026-10-14 15:43 UTC through the archive's TAP service. This is the same table and the same default parameter set that host_masses_v385.json took the stellar mass from; what is added here are the uncertainties, which that record did not carry. Both the planetary and the stellar parameters of this row are Agol et al. (2021), PSJ 2, 1.
_query: select pl_name,hostname,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,st_mass,st_masserr1,st_masserr2 from ps where pl_name='TRAPPIST-1 b' and default_flag=1
_units: pl_orbper d, pl_orbsmax au, st_mass Msun
